verdict.rationale: YYLO Skills is a locally installed pack of agent skill and instruction files for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Pi that drive the YYLO CLI and Ledger. Nothing in the evidence shows the product collecting or hosting user data in a way where AI-training use could apply. Whether data is used for training is up to the underlying model providers or hosted services, not a skill pack, so this axis does not apply to this product type.
